findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 33% of the first screen is one empty block (1440×300px at 0,240).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: 1 section(s) follow the one before with under 12% of the screen between their content: "Where and how to reach it" 74px under "Instruments of the lesson room".
findings.fix: Give sections real space: about 16% of the screen or more between one section's last line and the next one's first (140px or more at 1440 by 900), the same step everywhere, more before a change of subject. A page where the next section is already there reads as cluttered.

findings.message: 3 grounds on the page, by the screens they cover: #2b2622 (the ink, 5.76 screens, over 4 sections); #ebe5e3 (the page, 3.02 screens); #d7d0cd (div.blk.blk-b, 0.9 screens).
findings.fix: One ground and one surface tone a step from it, and no tint between them. The ink grounds a band at most (the footer and one section), and so do a dealt field and the accent (one section each); a scene's veil or band takes one of these, never a tone sampled from its photograph, unless its own sheet asks for one (then that is the page's band). Every other section, panel and card takes one of these, a sheet in another colour (a white receipt on grey) is set on the section ground, and a piece of work keeps its own colours inside its picture.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.
